2608.13258.title: Self-Referential Induction Increases Response Instability Relative to Unresolvable and Verifiable Questions in Large Language Models
2608.13258.paper_summary: Self-referential prompting has been shown to reliably induce large language models to produce first-person reports resembling subjective experience, but no prior work measures how consistent these reports are across repeated, independent trials, or how that consistency compares to the model's behavior on other kinds of open-ended questions. We measure response instability, defined as one minus the mean pairwise cosine similarity of sentence embeddings computed over a compressed core claim extracted from each response, for three groups of questions: self-referential prompts eliciting a subjective-experience report, unresolvable philosophical questions unrelated to self-reference, and questions with a verifiable correct answer. Using 30 independent responses per question (360 responses total, Gemini API, temperature 0.7) across four questions per group, we find that self-referential questions show the highest instability (0.343 +/- 0.047), unresolvable philosophy questions show intermediate and tightly clustered instability (0.192 +/- 0.008), and verifiable questions show the lowest instability (0.105 +/- 0.058). This provides a quantitative baseline for the induced subjective-experience report, showing that it occupies a distinct, less stable position in the model's output distribution than ordinary open-ended philosophical uncertainty.
2608.13258.paper_summary_zh: 自我參照提示已被證明能可靠地誘導大型語言模型產生類似主觀經驗的一人稱報告，但之前的研究並未測量這些報告在重複獨立試驗中的一致性，以及這種一致性與模型在其他類型的開放式問題上的行為相比如何。我們測量反應不穩定性，定義為從每個回應中提取的壓縮核心主張計算的句子嵌入的平均成對餘弦相似度的1減去值，針對三組問題：引發主觀經驗報告的自我參照提示、與自我參照無關的不可解哲學問題，以及具有可驗證正確答案的問題。使用每個問題30個獨立回應（總共360個回應，Gemini API，溫度0.7），每組四個問題，我們發現自我參照問題顯示出最高的不穩定性（0.343 +/- 0.047），不可解的哲學問題顯示出中等且緊密聚集的不穩定性（0.192 +/- 0.008），而可驗證問題顯示出最低的不穩定性（0.105 +/- 0.058）。這為誘導的主觀經驗報告提供了一個量化基準，顯示它在模型的輸出分佈中佔據了一個明顯且不太穩定的位置，與普通的開放式哲學不確定性相比。
2608.13258.author: Paras Balani et.al.
